summary: General-purpose web-based assessment items — quizzes, tests and practice questions that render and score in a browser with no assessment platform behind them.
in_scope: Multiple choice — a stem and options, one correct answer
Multi-select ("select all that apply") via max-choices, with several correct options
Per-option points, weighted answers, and partial credit
Exact-set scoring via response-processing "match-correct" — every correct option and nothing else, or zero
Penalized distractors (an option that costs a point when selected)
A rationale on an option, shown once the candidate selects it and withheld from the presentation
Shuffled option order, and author-named option ids
Unscored polls — an item that collects a response without grading it
Multi-part items over a reading passage with numbered paragraphs, scored additively or conjunctively (both parts right for the point)
out_of_scope: Interaction types other than choice — text entry, ordering, matching, classification, hot text, hotspot and sliders are not implemented yet
Hot text — selecting a word or sentence inside the passage itself, at any granularity
Cloze passages — a blank inside running text needs an inline interaction, which does not exist yet
Test packages, sections, navigation and sequencing — L0180 authors single items
Rubric-scored prose or any free-text judgement; scoring is exact matching against a key
Delivery policy — timing, attempt limits, feedback timing, gradebooks
Vendor-specific formats — name the vendor and use that vendor's dialect instead
